text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: {0} meets up with a very chipper Hatsune.
text_block_list.orig_text: {0}は、上機嫌のハツネと出会う。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Lalala! ♪
Shioriiin! I'm on my way, so just sit tight!
text_block_list.orig_text:
るんるんる～ん♪
シオリ～ン、
もうすぐ行くから、
待っててね～☆

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Huh-wha-wha? Well, look who it is! It's {0}! 
What a coinkydink!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれれ？　
誰かと思えば{0}くんか！
奇遇だね！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Hm? I look pretty cheerful, huh?
Heehee, yeah, I guess I just can't hide it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
機嫌よさそうに見える？
えへへ～やっぱりわかっちゃうんだね～

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
See, I'm on my way to the farm to meet up with my sister!
It's been ages since we've seen each other, so I'm over
the moon just thinking about it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
実はね、
これから牧場に行って、
妹に会ってくるんだ！
久しぶりだから、
もうワックワクなんだよ～！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Her name's Shiorin. She's just the cuuutest sister ever! ♪
Oh, I just can't wait to see her!
text_block_list.orig_text:
シオリンって言って、
とっても可愛い妹なのだ♪
早く会いたいなぁ～！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're headed to the farm too?
Then let's go togeth—
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
{0}くんも牧場に用があるの？
じゃあ、
一緒に──

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Hey, {0}! Look out!
There's a puddle right by your...
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、{0}くん、足元危ないよ！
水たまりが……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
...feet. Too late... Sorry, it gets kinda slippery when it's
muddy out, huh? Are you okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ、
転んじゃった……
ぬかるんで、
すべりやすくなってたんだね。
大丈夫？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Normally, I'd use my powers to help you, but...
That's a big no-can-do for me today!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いつもなら超能力で助けてあげられたかもだけど……
でも、
今日はダメダメ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
If I use my powers and fall asleep, I'll miss my chance to meet
up with Shiorin! So even if you get into any trouble today,
I can't help you, got it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
超能力使って寝ちゃったら、
シオリンに会えなくなっちゃうもんね！
今日はキミがピンチになっても、
何もできないから注意してね～

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Now leeet's boogie!
text_block_list.orig_text: じゃあ、牧場にしゅっぱ～つ！

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Waaah! I'm scared!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわぁあああん！
怖いよぉ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
That dog's scaring that kid! I've gotta do something!
But... but I can't use my powers...
text_block_list.orig_text:
子どもが犬に怯えてる！？　
助けなきゃ！
あ……
でも超能力、
使えないし……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
{0}! It just bit you! A-are you okay?!
We've gotta get that treated—
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん！　犬にかまれちゃった！
へ、
平気！？
早く治療を……

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Waaagh! Someone help me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわぁぁ！　
助けてくれ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
That man's being chased by a cat! Wait, what?
Uh... I guess he's scared of them or something?
text_block_list.orig_text:
今度は猫に追われてる人が……
って、
猫！？
苦手なのかな？

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: HISS!
text_block_list.orig_text: フシャーーー！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: {0}?! You really got scratched up! A-are you okay?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん！？
今度は猫に引っかかれちゃった！
だ、大丈夫！？

text_block_list.name: Small Thug
text_block_list.text: AAARGH! The horror! The horror! Somebody help!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ウォォォォ！　
　
だ、誰か助けてくれーーー！！！

text_block_list.name: Parrot
text_block_list.text: Chirp chirp! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text: ピピピ～♪

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: N-now we've got some parakeet trouble... Wait, seriously?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
今度はインコに追われてる人が……
って、
ええっ！？

text_block_list.name: Parrot
text_block_list.text: [i]*ANGRY CHIRPING*[/i]
text_block_list.orig_text: ピーーーーッ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Th-those pecks look vicious! {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、インコに突っつかれてる！
{0}くーん！！！

text_block_list.name: Large Thug
text_block_list.text: The hell did you just say to me?! You wanna go?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
んだ、コラ！　
やろうってのか！？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Oh geez, what now?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わわっ！　
今度はなに！？

text_block_list.name: Royal Guard
text_block_list.text:
Tell it to the judge, bub!
I'm putting you away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
言い訳は牢屋で聞こう！
連行させてもらう！

text_block_list.name: Large Thug
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, do your worst! You'll never take me alive!
Bring it, ya tin can!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やれるもんなら、力ずくでやってみろよ！
かかってきやがれ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what now? A fight with some ruffian and a knight?
I want to help, but... my powers...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
怖い人と騎士団の人がもめてる……？
助けたいけど……
超能力は使えないし……

text_block_list.name: Large Thug
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Who the hell are you?!
Get yer hands off of me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわっ！
テメェ、なにしやがる！　
放しやがれっ！

text_block_list.name: Royal Guard
text_block_list.text:
Wow, thank you for your help, young citizen! Just hold him down
for a bit longer. I'll get the restraints on him!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おぉ、
協力に感謝する！
もう少し、
そいつを抑えていてくれ！
すぐに手足を拘束する！

text_block_list.name: Large Thug
text_block_list.text: Damn you! You had no business buttin' in!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くそっ！
邪魔すんじゃねぇ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Holy moley...
{0}, you're incredible...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわぁ～
{0}くん、すごいなぁ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
{0}, you really took a beating back there.
Does it still hurt?
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん、
いっぱい怪我しちゃったね……
まだ痛む？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
I really wanted to help out too, but if I use my superpowers,
I'll fall right asleep...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私も本当は助けに行きたかったけど、
超能力を使ったら眠くなっちゃうから……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
But forget about me! You were amazing back there, {0}!
You don't even have superpowers and you just stepped right in!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
{0}くんはすごいね。
超能力もないのに、
すぐ助けにいって……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: I'm seriously super impressed! It's like, you're so—
text_block_list.orig_text:
私、
感動しちゃったよ～！
なんというか、
すっごく──

text_block_list.name: Old Man
text_block_list.text: Eeek! Somebody help!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひぇえええ！
誰かー！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAAAAGGGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! That monster's going after that old man!
Hey! You cut that out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああっ！　
魔物がおじいさんを襲ってる！？
こらー！　
やめなさーい！！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna send you mean monsters straight to next Sunday
with my superpowers! Take that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
悪い魔物は超能力でふっ飛ばしちゃうからっ！
えーいっ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Sweet! That takes care of that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よしっ！　
これで解決だよ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! I was so caught up in saving that old man... that
I... used... my superpowers... Oh no... I'm so... sleepy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あ！
さすがに見過ごせなくて、
超能力……
使っちゃ、
った……
どうしよう……
眠く、
なって……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Zzz! Zzz... Zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text:
スヤッ！
スヤスヤ……
スヤスヤ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Hnnngh! Now [i]that[/i] was a nice nap!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～！　
　
よく寝たぁ～！！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Wait, oh no! I wasn't supposed to fall asleep!
Oh geez, what am I gonna do?!
It's gonna get dark and I won't get to see Shiorin!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、ダメダメ！　
寝ちゃダメだったんだよ！
どどど、どうしよう！？
もう暗くなっちゃうし、
シオリンに会えないよぉ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, is this the farm?
Whoa! What am I doing on {0}'s back?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あれ？　
ここって牧場？
うわっ！　
なんで私、
{0}くんにおんぶされてるの！？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Huh? I fell asleep, so you carried me here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……私が寝ちゃったから、
ここまで運んでくれたの？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: W-wow... Heehee... Thank you so much, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そっか……
えへへ～、
ありがとう、
{0}くん！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Well, we've just got a bit longer 'till we get to Shiorin,
so I hope your back isn't sore yet!
choice_data_list: If you can talk, you can walk.
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
シオリンのところまで、
もう少しあるから、
そこまでお願いね♪

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Aww, you big jerk!
It's just a little farther, you can take it!
All aboard the {0} train!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇ～！　ケチー！
もうちょっとくらい、いいでしょー！
ほらほら、
しゅっぱーつっ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! You're the best. ♪
Heehee. Your back is so nice and warm.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わぁ～い、
ありがとう♪
えへへ、
{0}くんの背中、
あったかいね。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Shioriiin! I'm heeere!
text_block_list.orig_text:
シオリーン！
会いに来たよ！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Hatsune... You came to visit me? Thank you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉ちゃん……
来てくれたの？
ありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: It's been so long since I've seen you! I'm so glad you're here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
会うのは久しぶりだよね！
うれしいな～☆

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm glad to be here too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！　
お姉ちゃんもうれしいよっ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Though I didn't know if I was gonna make it or not today.
I wound up using my powers and fell asleep on the way here.
But then {0} carried me here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
今日も来られるかわからなかったんだよ……
途中で超能力使って、寝ちゃったから。
{0}くんが運んでくれたおかげだよ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Shiorin, Shiorin! You won't believe how cool {0} is!
He's always helping me out! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
シオリン、シオリン！
{0}くんはすごいんだよ！
私のこと、いつもいつも助けてくれるんだっ♪

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Well, thank you very much, {0}.
To think you'd be helping my sister as well...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうなんだ……
{0}さん、
ありがとうございました。
お姉ちゃんまでご迷惑をかけてしまったんですね……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Hey! What's going on here?!
Do you two know each other?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
なになに！？
二人って知り合いだったの！？

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Yes. He helps me out a lot as well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん。
私も、{0}さんには、
いつもいろいろ助けてもらってるの。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Grr...! Not cool! I'm not cool with this at all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
…………ムゥ～！　
なんか納得できないっ！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: You're not...? Why? What's wrong?
text_block_list.orig_text:
納得って……？
お姉ちゃん、
どうかしたの？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't know why!
All I know is that I'm real upset about it!
You're the worst, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、わかんない！
とにかくモヤモヤするのっ！
{0}くんのバカ～っ！
